title: bounded-delta-detector-for-kv-hit-transitions-with-mini-golden-sets
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Problem statement: We observe nondeterministic output shifts when requests that previously missed the KV/prefix cache become hits after configuration or model changes. Existing evals surface large regressions but don't reliably detect small, systematic per-token drifts caused by cache-warmup/placement changes. Goal: implement a bounded-delta detection system that (1) quantifies per-token and per-response deltas conditioned specifically on miss->hit transitions, (2) uses small stratified "mini-golden" prompt sets representing critical archetypes, and (3) emits signal for automated rollout gating and prioritization for human review.
acceptance_criteria: Node-level detector computes token-wise L1/L2 and KL deltas for hit vs miss replay and exposes per-prompt and aggregate deltas
Mini-golden set of ~200 prompts (10 archetypes x 20 variants) defined and stored in immutable eval bucket
Detector integrates with routing to instrument control traffic (1% baseline) and captures hit-flag context in traces
Thresholded alerts fire if bounded-delta exceeds per-archetype SLA (token-L1 > 0.08 avg or >5% responses with >0.2 token-L1)
Automated canary user shows diff heatmap and top-10 impacted prompts in Console; runbook for rollback documented
design_decisions: Use token-aligned logit-space L1 and KL on top-k normalized distributions rather than only probability of top token — more sensitive to subtle distribution shifts
Stratify mini-golden sets by archetype (instruction, multi-turn dialog, code, math, tabular ref, completion) to reduce false positives from distributional mismatch
Replay harness will simulate both hot and cold warmup by toggling KV insertion sequence to reproduce miss->hit semantics deterministically
Keep detector lightweight at inference path by sampling 1 in N requests for detailed capture; heavy aggregation runs offline into the eval pipeline to calculate deltas
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: noisy baseline due to upstream model changes. Mitigation: require stable-model tag and compare only across identical model build ids
Risk: increased telemetry cost. Mitigation: cap detailed captures to 1% global and 5% for flagged canaries; compress and batch upload
Risk: false alarms on low-frequency archetypes. Mitigation: minimum-sample filters and moving-average smoothing before alerting
implementation_plan: Phase 1 (week 1): define mini-golden archetypes and seed prompt corpus; create immutable S3 bucket and metadata manifest
Phase 2 (week 2): instrument runtime to tag hit/miss and emit minimal token logits for sampled requests; wire into trace spans
Phase 3 (week 3): offline aggregator job: align tokens between hit/miss replay, compute per-token L1/KL, and produce per-prompt summaries
Phase 4 (week 4): Console integration for heatmaps and per-archetype thresholds; alerting rules and runbook finalization
Phase 5 (post-rollout): iterate thresholds, expand mini-golden corpus, and add model-variant-aware baselines
work_items: Create golden prompt manifest and archetype mapping (PR: github.com/redwood/evl-protos/pulls/124)
Runtime instrumentation: hit/miss flag + sampled token-logit capture (PR: github.com/redwood/runtime/pulls/982)
Console visualization and alert deck (Design spec: confluence.redwood.ai/display/EVAL/Bounded+Delta+Heatmap)
Add e2e smoke canary to dedicated pools before full rollout
